claude.sample_unit: referral scenarios (each triaged 3 times by 23 LLMs under 2 prompt conditions)
models_evaluated: 23 contemporary large language models (individual names not listed in the text)

links.outcome: Reproducibility across repeated runs and effect of prompting on between-model variance in accuracy
links.effect: Each LLM triaged every referral three times; advanced prompting reduced between-model variance in accuracy 5.3-fold (0.014 to 0.003; Levene P=.01) and all 2760 attempts returned valid categories.
links.quote: Advanced prompting minimised between-model variance in accuracy 5.3-fold (0.014 to 0.003; Levene P=.01), abolished the size-accuracy association (rho=-0.05; P=.83) and removed the accuracy-cost relationship.

links.outcome: Under-triage errors (missed urgency) by LLMs in referral urgency categorisation
links.effect: Under-triage errors persisted with some LLMs, though leading models matched expert consensus on most cases.
links.quote: Under-triage errors persisted with some LLMs.

links.outcome: LLM triage accuracy versus expert consensus and published human triage accuracy
links.effect: Leading models matched expert consensus on most cases, within or above the range reported for human triage; LLMs categorise urgency as well or better than published human triage systems.
links.quote: Leading models matched expert consensus on most cases, within or above the range reported for human triage.

unlisted_practices: Advanced prompting with explicit triage expectations and worked examples to improve LLM accuracy
Using smaller/cheaper models with advanced prompting instead of larger costlier models

openai.sample_unit: LLM triage attempts across 20 referral scenarios

links.outcome: Accuracy by model size and cost
links.effect: Simple prompt: performance tiers; larger models more accurate (Spearman rho = 0.42; P=.047) and accuracy tracked cost.
links.quote: Under the simple prompt, performance separated into distinct tiers, larger models were more accurate (Spearman rho = 0.42; P=.047) and accuracy tracked cost.
